programs.name: comb_fingers_south
programs.rationale: A spine on the north with five fingers reaching south: every room gets the open side.

programs.name: comb_grid
programs.rationale: Two ranks of bars offset against each other, leaving a run of courts between them.

programs.name: comb_branched
programs.rationale: A trunk that throws off an arm - the smallest comb there is, and the clearest.

programs.name: notch_corner_block
programs.rationale: One corner removed from a compact block - the notch is the address and nothing else changes.

programs.name: notch_chamfer
programs.rationale: A single oblique cut across one corner turns a box into a figure that has a front.

programs.name: notch_south_slot
programs.rationale: Two bites out of one plate: a corner for the light, a slot on the south for the door.

programs.name: notch_punctured
programs.rationale: A deep plate punched three times so daylight reaches its middle - the holes make the plan possible.

programs.name: interlock_pair
programs.rationale: Two bars locked through each other at a right angle - neither is the host, and the lock is the plan.

programs.name: interlock_stacked
programs.rationale: A second bar laid across the first one storey up, each carrying the other's overhang.

programs.name: oblique_shear_block
programs.rationale: A block sheared along its height: every face stays flat and the whole leans.

programs.name: twist_tower
programs.rationale: A shaft that rotates as it rises - one continuous deformation, no tiers.

programs.name: taper_tower
programs.rationale: A shaft narrowing continuously to its top - the taper is the section and the silhouette both.

programs.name: hall_profiled_section
programs.rationale: A long-span hall whose roof is a sawtooth - the section, not the plan, is the architecture.

programs.name: overlap_plates
programs.rationale: Two plates overlapping in section and shifted in plan - the overlap is the shared room.

programs.name: embed_atrium
programs.rationale: A void set fully inside the block: an atrium that is read only from within, and from the roof.

programs.name: offset_twin_plates
programs.rationale: A plate and its smaller offset relative, held a slot apart along the short axis.

programs.name: bridge_two_wings
programs.rationale: Two parallel wings held apart and then linked - the bridge makes the gap between them a court.

programs.name: court_slab_south
programs.rationale: A wide plate holds three sides and lets the fourth go: the court opens on the parcel's one free edge.

programs.name: court_deep_block
programs.rationale: A compact block hollowed on the south face - the void is the room, the block is the wall around it.

programs.name: court_on_plinth
programs.rationale: The court is cut into a body that already steps back from the north: two ideas, one of them subordinate.

programs.name: court_slot_bar
programs.rationale: One slot driven into the long south flank of a bar - a court that reads as an event in a wall.

programs.name: court_round
programs.rationale: A rounded host with its centre taken out and one mouth to the south - a ring, not a lump.

programs.name: spine_bent_bar
programs.rationale: One bar, one hinge in plan: the spine turns to face the open side and the turn is the whole idea.

programs.name: spine_bend_entry
programs.rationale: A continuously curved spine, notched once on the south where the public arrives.

programs.name: spine_split_kink
programs.rationale: The bar breaks once and the two lengths take different bearings while staying one body.

programs.name: spine_bend_lifted
programs.rationale: A bent bar set down on piers so the ground beneath it stays continuous with the open side.

programs.name: spine_fracture
programs.rationale: One long body fractured across its length so the two halves shift and read as a single articulated spine.

programs.name: plinth_tower_offset
programs.rationale: A low plate covers the parcel and one shaft rises off its far end - the plinth is the public floor.

programs.name: plinth_tower_podium
programs.rationale: One body that reads as podium and shaft because the setbacks are large and start low.

programs.name: plinth_tower_nested
programs.rationale: A smaller volume seated within the plate's own footprint - carried, not merely stacked beside it.

programs.name: plinth_tower_wide_base
programs.rationale: A shaft standing centred on a broad low base: the base takes the ground, the shaft takes the height.

programs.name: lifted_plate_south
programs.rationale: The whole plate is raised one storey on piers that reach the ground, giving the parcel back its open side.

programs.name: lifted_bar_piers
programs.rationale: A bar carried clear of the ground on a stub that reaches it - the space below is the entrance.

programs.name: lifted_court_slab
programs.rationale: A ring plate with an internal light court, lifted so the public ground runs under it.

programs.name: gate_under_block
programs.rationale: A block whose lower south face is taken away, so the mass passes over the entrance.

programs.name: step_ziggurat
programs.rationale: Five steps back in one direction: a section that gives every level its own sky.

programs.name: step_tower_setback
programs.rationale: A shaft that loses depth as it rises, so the section is read from the street, not the plan.

programs.name: step_terrace_south
programs.rationale: Terraces stepping down toward the open side - the building descends to meet its one public edge.

programs.name: step_graded_ground
programs.rationale: The south face is graded into occupiable steps - a landscape cut out of the building's own body.

programs.name: step_shifted_stack
programs.rationale: Five equal plates each stepped off the one below - the stagger is the whole section.
